parameters.name: ExtendedConfig.CustomData
parameters.description:
The custom data in the extended configuration of the secret.

> *   If this parameter is specified, the existing extended configuration of the secret is updated.
> *   This parameter is unavailable for generic secrets.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun kms update-secret --secret-name secret001 --description datainfo --extended-config-custom-data Port=3306 DBName=app1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun kms UpdateSecret --region cn-hangzhou --SecretName secret001 --ExtendedConfig.CustomData '{"Port":"3306","DBName":"app1"}' --Description datainfo
